Senses.Explanation: A time-span marker that stretches from a named past event straight to the present, almost always to sharpen what still stands unresolved: a line no one has raised, a marvel no one has gotten, a parting never verified. Song records set the span's work: Yuanwu Keqin raises Zhaozhou's hearth-side no-guest-no-host line and marks that no one has raised it down to this moment; Xutang Zhiyu holds twenty-five years since his late teacher's death open in a verse, missing Songyuan's three turning words to this day; Dahui Zonggao and Dachuan Puji each strike the staff over the stock couplet that Vipasyin set his mind on it early yet no one has gotten its marvel down to this moment; Wuzhun Shifan's enlightenment-day verse leaves the old foreigner nothing to grasp since the morning star. Later records keep the span taut: Baichi Xingyuan and Feiyin Tongrong raise the same Zhaozhou line again, one praising it as scooping the moon from water, one ruling the old man's display of his own shortcomings an unshaken habit; Azi Jinwu runs the three-legged donkey and the bride on the donkey, marking the mouth as the gate of trouble where the marvel is still unclaimed; Shixi Xinyue offers the parting at Vulture Peak down to this moment as the greeting before the throne, rising with folded hands; Jieshi Zhipeng's birthday verse weighs the orchid-ladle grief of a poison carried from the womb to this day.
